title: Transmission component slipping
plainEnglishMeaning: The PCM detected an unexpected speed difference while evaluating transmission or torque-converter operation.
enableCriteria: The reproduced Roadmaster chart describes monitoring in D3 or D4, indicated gears 2 through 4, with the torque-converter clutch commanded locked.
failureCriteria: The exact permitted speed difference and duration are not yet verified.

likelyCauses.cause: Torque-converter clutch or internal transmission slip
Poor contact at the transmission pass-through connector

falsePositiveConditions: Incorrect range information or a connector fault can corrupt the PCM's slip evaluation.
confirmatoryTests: Confirm that the reported range agrees with the selector.
Record engine speed, output speed, gear, and torque-converter-clutch command during a safe steady cruise.
Measure hydraulic pressure if the electrical commands are correct but slip is repeatable.
safetyLevel: Avoid heavy load until repeatable slip is evaluated
